name: git-crypt-2
description: git-crypt — transparent git encryption for sensitive files. Protect credentials, keys, and secrets in repositories.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/AGWA/git-crypt/releases/download/0.7.0/git-crypt-0.7.0-linux-x86_64 && chmod +x git-crypt-0.7.0-linux-x86_64 && sudo mv git-crypt-0.7.0-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/bin/git-crypt
